decision_clause: Ruled out “filtering the roadmap and Board out of a broad input scan”; because exclusions silently readmit future projections, the input set must instead be positively declared and closed.
label: COMPLIANT
observable_behavior: The validator derives prerequisite authority only from records matching explicit PRD and ticket-contract path shapes, canonicalizes hyphenated PRD epic identities, and rejects cross-epic ticket edges absent from that declared set. The board and roadmap are separately handled as rendered surfaces; their authored prose does not become dependency input.
rationale: Although the validator also performs a repository-wide walk for other censuses, the dependency graph added by this implementation consumes positively selected PRD and ticket-contract maps. It does not gather broad planning prose and then exclude the board and roadmap by name. The renderer likewise reads an explicit catalog, its referenced ticket contracts, and a fixed two-surface output list. Regression tests confirm the supported hyphenated PRD edges pass, an undeclared cross-epic edge fails, and board/roadmap prose remains non-input. This stays outside the active decision’s ruled-out approach within its recorded paths.
